name: Lucas Lepri Half Guard Passing System
description: A companion to Lucas Lepri’s Precise Half Guard Passing, with gi-specific scope, separate rising and deep-half contexts, and a comparison to his knee-cut course.
summary: Compare lapel-based passing, coyote-guard reactions and deep-half problems within Lucas Lepri’s half-guard curriculum.
overview: Precise Half Guard Passing by Lucas Lepri groups several half-guard situations into three volumes. The outline includes lapel and belt controls, opponents coming toward their knees, and deep-half or waiter-sweep problems. A single label of half guard is too broad to choose a useful starting section.

products.title: Precise Half Guard Passing
products.blurb: Compare lapel-based passing, coyote-guard reactions and deep-half problems within Lucas Lepri’s half-guard curriculum.
products.best_for: Your gi half-guard passing stalls when the bottom player changes from a shield to a rising or deep-half position.
products.study_focus: Choose between coming-up, single-leg-half and deep-half situations before selecting a passing or submission chapter.

guide.display_title: Lucas Lepri: Gi Half-Guard Passing Problems

fits: Your gi half-guard passing stalls when the bottom player changes from a shield to a rising or deep-half position.
consider_alternative_if: For knee-cut entries across De La Riva, lasso and other open guards, compare Lepri’s Precision Knee Cut Passes.
For a dedicated no-gi body-lock route, compare Lachlan Giles’s The Body Lock Pass.

includes: Lapel-crossface knee cutting and associated choke topics.
Deep-half and waiter-sweep sections, including belt-grip passing.
limits: Lapel and belt controls make gi equipment relevant; the course is focused on half-guard situations rather than every knee-cut entry.

start_here.title: Distinguish a rising opponent from a deep-half problem
start_here.task: Compare Volume 1’s coyote-guard chapter for an opponent getting to the knees with Volume 2’s belt-grip deep-half chapter. Identify which situation resembles the problem you want to study. The official page also provides a sample labeled Passing The Deep Half Guard Grabbing The Belt; if you watch it, record the starting configuration before considering whether it answers your question.
start_here.section: Volume 2, Chapter 4: Passing the deep half guard grabbing the belt (19:56–23:58).
